mapper.sql: id , pid, path, name, title, icon, component, redirect, sort, deep, menu_type_cd, permissions, is_hidden, has_children, is_link, is_full, is_affix, is_keep_alive, create_time, update_time, create_id, update_id, del_flag
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_menu AS m JOIN (SELECT id, IF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys_menu WHERE pid = sub_m.id), 'T', 'F') AS has_children FROM sys_menu AS sub_m WHERE 1 = 1 and sub_m.del_flag = 0) AS subquery ON m.id = subquery.id SET m.has_children = 'T' WHERE subquery.has_children = 'T';
UPDATE sys_menu AS m JOIN sys_menu AS parent ON m.pid = parent.id SET m.deep = parent.deep + 1 WHERE 1 = 1 and m.del_flag = 0;

UPDATE sys_menu AS m SET del_flag = 1 WHERE m.id IN (SELECT id FROM (WITH RECURSIVE MenuCTE AS (SELECT id, pid FROM sys_menu WHERE id = #{nodeId} UNION ALL SELECT sm.id, sm.pid FROM sys_menu sm JOIN MenuCTE cte ON sm.pid = cte.id) SELECT id FROM MenuCTE) AS subquery);
mapper.select: select distinct sys_menu.permissions from sys_menu left join sys_role_menu on sys_menu.id = sys_role_menu.menu_id left join sys_user_role on sys_role_menu.role_id = sys_user_role.role_id where sys_user_role.user_id = #{userId} and sys_menu.permissions is not null and sys_menu.permissions != '';
select sys_user_data_role.user_id from sys_user_data_role left join sys_data_role_menu on sys_user_data_role.role_id = sys_data_role_menu.role_id where sys_data_role_menu.menu_id = #{menuId};
